Delta review of `6a800e5ce..4ed48f68f`. This review covers the hand-resolved merge of `main` only. The earlier review of the branch content stands.

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What the merge resolution did

The merge commit `4ed48f68f` joins `6a800e5ce` (branch) with `6349a542e` (main). Two files had conflicts. The remerge-diff shows only these hunks; every other file took a clean auto-merge.

- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`, three hunks (`overlay_labels`, `gizmo_segments`, `collect_overlay`): the resolution keeps both sides. Each axis loop now has the `if !shown[axis] { continue; }` guard from this PR and the `let dir = gizmo.axis_dir(axis, dir);` line from main. Count check: 3 guards in the branch head, 3 `axis_dir` calls in main, 3 of each in the new head. No lost hunk, no duplicate block.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`, one hunk: the module list keeps `mod lathe_gizmo;` (branch) and `mod floor;` with its `#2172` comment (main). Union of both sides.
- No conflict markers remain in either file.

The diff of the head against current main for `interact.rs` is exactly the intended change: 3 `axes_shown` reads and 3 guards, on top of main's `axis_dir` rework. That is the 14 lines added and 2 removed that the body states.

## Results, local

Run in a review worktree at `4ed48f68f`, CWD `crates/ui`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `git merge-tree origin/main 4ed48f68f` | clean, single tree |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` | 1881 passed, 13 ignored, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib lathe_gizmo` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Notes, not blocking

- The body's "Merge of main" section says the merge was clean. That described the earlier merge at `6a800e5ce`. The new merge had the two conflicts above. The issue comment records it. No body change asked for.
- The body's note about `MachineKind::Waterjet` (E0004 on main) no longer applies: main has that arm now, and the suites built here without a local edit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
